lines: Keep running. I am not leaving the village for you.
Go on. I have better things to protect than my pride.
You are not worth chasing any farther.
Do not mistake distance for forgiveness.
This is not over. The village will remember you.
I know your face now. That is enough.
Stay gone if you know what is good for you.
Run while you can. I am warning the others.
I will not be lured away from my home.
You wanted a chase. You will get a warning instead.
Fine. Leave. We will be ready if you return.
Take one more step away and keep going.
I have seen enough of you for one day.
Go. Every door in this village will know your name.
I am done following you. I am not done remembering.
That was your warning. Now get out.
One strike is enough. Leave us alone.
Now you know we are not helpless.
I made my point. Leave the village.
Call that mercy and do not test it again.
I do not need to win. I needed you to listen.
You felt that. Stay away from us.
I have done what I came to do. Go.
That is enough blood for today.
Remember that blow before you raise your hand again.
I stood my ground. Now you can leave it.
We are even for now. Do not come back.
You were warned once. There will not be another warning.
I got my answer. You can keep your distance.
Go before my courage returns.
Run back to whatever hole you came from.
Keep running. Distance does not make you innocent.
You escaped me, not the consequences.
I will not abandon the village just to catch you.
Go. The others will hear what you did.
You are beyond my reach, but not my memory.
Do not think getting away makes this finished.
I know where you ran. Stay there.
The village comes first. You can keep fleeing.
Coward! Keep moving and do not turn back.
You got away this time. There may not be a next time.
I will remember you when you come crawling back.
Run. We have walls to guard and names to share.
That is far enough. Now stay away.
Next time you may not be fast enough.
Where did you go? Show yourself!
Hide if you want. We still know what you did.
I know you are still out there somewhere.
You cannot hide from the whole village forever.
Come out and face what you started.
Gone, but not forgiven.
I lost your trail. I will not forget your face.
Stay hidden. It is safer for everyone.
They slipped away. Warn the others.
I cannot see you, but I know you are near.
Quiet now. Too quiet.
You chose the shadows. Remember why you needed them.
No sign of you. Good. Keep it that way.
I will stop looking, but I will stay ready.
The trail ends here. The grudge does not.
